Subject: Take-home packet: staggered cohort schedule & reviewer sign-up

Hi Zoe —

Thanks again for your time on the interview earlier. Attached is the take-home prompt (takehome_prompt_v3.pdf) and the evaluation rubric we’ll use. To make scheduling fair across time zones and reviewer load we’re running two staggered cohorts:

- Cohort A (standard): submit by Tue, April 12 23:59 PT — target for most candidates.
- Cohort B (extended): submit by Fri, April 16 23:59 PT — for candidates who request extra time or need weekend buffer.

Please reply to confirm which cohort you’d like to join. Submission instructions are in the prompt (PDF) — we prefer a single ZIP with a README and any notebooks (label your files like lastname_firstname_*). You can upload to the Google Drive link below or reply with the ZIP attached.

Reviewers: We’ll assign two reviewers (one engineering, one product) and aim to provide feedback within 5 business days of the submission deadline for your cohort. If you have a strong preference for Cohort A but need a brief extension for a personal reason, let us know and we’ll try to accommodate within Cohort B if necessary.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d--takehome

Attachments: takehome_prompt_v3.pdf (PDF), evaluation_rubric.csv (CSV)

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Recruiting Partner, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
